answer: In this PoA design, bonded collateral is locked per identity, while evidence linking k coordinated equivocations triggers a penalty proportional to k², not k. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss across the sybil swarm, making extra identities amplify shared risk rather than dilute it. Asymmetric depreciation ensures slashed collateral loses value faster than honest bonds accrue it; velvet, dune, and hollow are merely labels, never exemptions from correlated-proof accounting.
